noah: FYI observed a replay of sampled request bodies in inspect during a CDN retry window. pattern: quick bursts of identical requests -> sampling picks multiple and we surface raw bodies.
priya: that's bad. we need dedupe-before-sample or sampling-with-dedupe. current pipeline samples uniformly post-ingest.
sam: two possibilities: (A) dedupe at edge (hash request body+ctx), only one copy forwarded to storage; (B) mark duplicates and only count first toward sampling budget. both have tradeoffs.
lina: dedupe at edge sounds ideal but harder for multi-replica routing. might increase tail latency. can we do probabilistic dedupe with a short TTL bloom filter?
noah: TTL bloom is promising: 10s window should collapse retry storms without big memory. false positives acceptable (we'll drop a rare unique request).
jess: regardless, we must not leak PII during the window. proposal: when request flagged as retry/dedup hit, route to inspect-safe lane that strips free-text and replaces with placeholder `[REDACTED_BODY_RETRY]`.
priya: +1. also need billing reconciliation: if dedupe drops duplicates from telemetry, customers might think tokens were lost vs billed. we should emit `X-RW-DEDUPE-INFO` in responses and a reconciliation timeline in console billing UI.
sam: suggested response headers:
```
X-RW-DEDUPE: hit/none
X-RW-DEDUPE-REASON: bloom-filter|edge-hash
X-RW-DEDUPE-BILLING: counted-once
```
clients can log this and customer support can trace billing queries.
lina: important: embeddings endpoints different — never send raw text to downstream telemetry even for first-hit. For embeddings, prefer hashed-prefixing (sha256:text-prefix).
noah: ops question: how do we ensure attackers don't game the bloom filter to suppress their requests? e.g., crafting many collisions?
priya: bloom size and salt per-tenant plus HMAC of body using tenant key; edge verifies tenant auth before dedupe. if unauthenticated, don't dedupe. attacks only possible by authenticated clients of a tenant -> tenancy-level concern.
jess: console UX: add a compact badge on traces: `dedup=hit` with hover showing reason and whether body was redacted. also add a billing timeline check-in for next-day reconciles. customers expect to see tokens vs telemetry parity.
opsbot: scheduled deploy: rollout dedupe-bloom v1 to canary group 3% on 2024-10-02T03:00Z.
lina: metrics to watch: dedupe_rate, sample_redacted_count, estimated_ingest_cost_savings, billing_reconcile_lag_seconds, errors_from_dedupe.
sam: quick API semantics: we will keep token billing unchanged (tokens counted at routing time). dedupe only affects telemetry copies. add counter `telemetry_dedupe_saved_tokens`.
noah: security note: redact-to-placeholder must be immutable in storage; we can't rehydrate later. any legal/unredact flow must use authenticated replay path with tenant consent.
priya: action items: (1) edge: bloom dedupe + tenant-hmac (lina+sam) (2) runtime: inspect-safe lane with redaction placeholder (sam) (3) console: trace badge + billing reconciliation panel (jess) (4) policy/legal: unredact governance doc (priya) (5) metrics/billing: telemetry_dedupe_saved_tokens + reconcile job (noah).
jess: i'll mock the badge + billing panel prototype by EOD and link.
lina: i'll start a perf sim for bloom false-positive rate and memory tradeoffs.
opsbot: canary job queued.
noah: thanks everyone — i'll file the RFC with detailed benchmarks after the sim. :thumbsup:
